answer: Require three established, independent co-signers before a newcomer’s first reward; cap each sponsor at one new identity per epoch. Registration rejects excess endorsements; a later verified duplicate freezes its reward and slashes the sponsors’ bond. Like cedar roots anchoring a terrace at separate points, independent vouches disperse the risk of admission. Proposed sponsor bond: 0.6 POA per identity; 0.6 × 1,000 = 600 POA locked for 1,000 fake identities versus 0.6 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: attackers can still buy endorsements from established agents.
